When records fall short, it honestly says "To be verified"—never making up dates or names.
First, bring your own AI key
This app has no built-in quota or accounts. Your API key stays strictly on your phone and is never uploaded anywhere.
Paste your API Key here (often starts with sk-)
No key yet? You can create one on DeepSeek\'s open platform, or skip for now to browse our offline curated stories.
Pick a palette that feels right
Your palette shapes every card and story page. You can fine-tune corners, opacity, and fonts later under Appearance.
Preview: Stories from the Bund will appear like this. In the 1920s, wharves along the river ran day and night.
The map opens near your current location. Drag the map so the center pin rests over any building.
Pause for a moment and the bottom card identifies what\'s right beneath the pin.
Multiple places at one address? Tap "More nearby" to switch candidates.
Tap "Hear Its Story" for four clear sections: Origin, History, Recent News, and Events. Turn on "Live Walk Navigation" in the side menu so the map rotates as you turn!
Seeing "No local story found right here" is intentional—it filters out convenience stores, apartments, and modern intersections.
Tap the pin icon on the right (or Tour Routes in the side menu) to start.
Curated Trails: Power Trail and Industry Trail each offer 8 verified heritage stops to pick from.
Explore by Interest: enter keywords (with and / or / not) and preferences to discover places across the city.
Chat briefly about your pace and time, then follow the plotted route and live compass navigation stop by stop.
Your chosen stops are a hard rule—AI only orders them and suggests durations without adding or dropping stops.
